Reflection: The Bookmark Manager is open and “Bookmarks bar” is selected. To create the new “Favorites” folder, I’ll open the “Organize” menu and choose “Add new folder.”

```python
import pyautogui
import time

# Open the Organize menu in Bookmark Manager
pyautogui.click(1872, 163)  # click the "Organize" button
time.sleep(0.5)

# Click "Add new folder"
pyautogui.click(1872, 210)  # approximate location of "Add new folder" in the dropdown
time.sleep(0.5)

# Type folder name and confirm
pyautogui.typewrite('Favorites')
time.sleep(0.2)
pyautogui.press('enter')
```
